contexts.text: A vapour exhales from (the Hell of the avaricious) like that from swine being scraped in a scalding trough.
Hence the avaricious appear to themselves to be among swine.
(The confirmed Quakers) appear at a distance like wild swine. SE 3785. LJPost 59.
A peasant (who) sits down to a table on which is swine's flesh...
The forms of beasts under which the lascivious delights of scortatory love are presented to view, are swine, etc.
There appear to the left huge swine joined together, by which are represented the earthy matters which are in urine, and are separated from the serum [of the blood]...
Those not in conjugial love are like swine and pigs as to all things. This was confirmed by one such who appeared like a hog, and who devoured excrements with delight.
Ignatius... fled from adoration, by making himself as filthy as a swine.
To eat swine's flesh () = to appropriate to one's self infernal evils.
In the brothels in Hell... adulteresses are seen lying with adulterers, like swine in filth.
